indication: Endothelial decompensation (Table 2): Fuchs endothelial dystrophy 46, pseudophakic bullous keratopathy 32, laser-iridotomy-induced decompensation 15, ICE syndrome 3, CMV endotheliitis 3, CHED 2, unknown 1 of 102 eyes; 57 pseudophakic and 45 phakic; 42 combined with phacoemulsification and IOL implantation

groups.description: DSAEK with donor corneas from EBAA-accredited US eye banks shipped to Thailand (death-to-operation at least 8 days); Moria ALTK microkeratome (33 surgeon-cut, 69 eye-bank precut), Busin glide insertion, air tamponade; two surgeons; retrospective case series 2006-2014, 102 eyes of 95 patients
